title: operator-scope KMS proof and non-repudiation audit proxy
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: tighten operator-scoped KMS usage assertions and improve audit non-repudiation for service-level region pinning. This PR introduces an operator-scope KMS claim enforcer that validates KMS key origin and tenant/service binding at request time, a lightweight non-repudiation audit proxy that signs audit envelopes with a platform key and cohorts sensitive audit entries to reduce PII blast radius, migration for service metadata to store kms_zone, and feature-flagged rollout to avoid immediate global impact. Changes include RBAC v2 policy hooks to surface operator-scoped decisions, updates to the decision cache to include KMS provenance assertions, and a new audit proxy that sits between the request pipeline and the audit sink to add signed envelopes and cohort headers. Commits: 1) add operator_kms_assertor core logic and interfaces; 2) wire RBAC v2 evaluator to pass KMS provenance into decision context; 3) add DB migration to persist kms_zone on service records; 4) implement non-repudiation audit proxy and envelope signer; 5) feature flag and rollout scripts; 6) integration tests for region pinning and KMS enforcement; 7) docs and runbook. Migration notes: run migrations/20241115_add_kms_zone.sql before enabling feature flag. Rollout plan: enable flag in staging, 5% canary in prod for 24h, monitor audit signing rates and RBAC decision failures, then ramp. Backwards compatibility: default behavior is allowlist fallback where missing kms_zone or legacy services fall through to existing KMS resolver until metadata is populated. Monitoring and alerts: new metrics operator_kms_assertor.decision_failure and audit_proxy.signed_envelopes; SLOs around audit signing latency documented in runbook. CLI helper: tools/migrate_kms_zone.sh to backfill services. Related: ENG-4219 covers policy design; SUP-1284 is the support ticket that motivated stricter KMS checks.
